channel.title: Malibu · Blog
channel.description: Network updates, engineering notes, and the ideas behind turning idle Apple Silicon into the world's biggest AI cloud.

item.title: Malibu's pre-beta is rolling out, one Mac at a time
item.description: Malibu's private pre-beta is rolling out to its first Apple Silicon providers. They are serving real inference before the network has paid a cent.

item.title: The signed receipt your inference API doesn't ship
item.description: Every Malibu response carries a nine-field Ed25519 receipt you can verify offline with an open-source CLI. No other commercial inference API ships one.

item.title: Turning on the world's biggest AI cloud
item.description: Two hundred million Apple Silicon Macs are already deployed, already paid for, and idle twenty hours a day. Malibu turns them on.
